verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials is a fair question for a government service that exposes machine endpoints, so the axis applies. The evidence shows api.uspto.gov requires an authentication token, which implies some API-key model, but nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials, per-agent keys, or permission limits. Sponsored-staff delegation in Patent Center is an account-level UI feature, not a scoped API credential, so it earns no credit here.
